newsitem.title: UK: UK Connex train drivers to re-impose overtime ban.
newsitem.headline: UK Connex train drivers to re-impose overtime ban.

text.p: Train drivers for south-east England regional operator Connex, owned by French utility Cie Generale des Eaux, are resuming their ban on overtime work, ASLEF, the drivers' union said on Monday.
A ban on overtime and rest day working by Connex South Central drivers was suspended last week to allow fresh negotiations between ASLEF and Connex management.
But an ASLEF spokesman said the ban would be re-imposed from July 8 as revised proposals from the talks were unacceptable and did not meet the "aspirations of our membership".
While industrial action would now restart once the notice period expired, the ASLEF spokesman said the union remained available for negotiations with management.
